controls.name: C_honest_jobs_accepted_by_both
controls.must_fire_because: both routes must ACCEPT the honest job, or the comparison is between a verifier and a broken verifier rather than between two ways of deciding the same question
controls.can_fail_because: any honest job is rejected by either route
controls.null_must_contain: a verifier that rejects everything would score perfectly on the cheat worlds and fail here

controls.name: C_replication_works_when_independent
controls.must_fire_because: replication must CATCH the liar when the peer is honest -- otherwise world 3 proves nothing, because the baseline would be broken rather than blind
controls.can_fail_because: the honest-peer world is not caught at 100%
controls.null_must_contain: a replication check that cannot see a differing answer at all

controls.name: C_all_three_tampers_rejected
controls.must_fire_because: the single verifier must reject an OMITTED, an ADDED and an ALTERED answer -- one tamper class rejected could be an accident of encoding
controls.can_fail_because: any tamper class has rejected < n
controls.null_must_contain: a verifier that only checks the answer count, which would accept the altered key

controls.name: C_jobs_have_real_answers
controls.must_fire_because: a job whose answer is one or two keys makes omission trivial and the demonstration vacuous; jobs below three answers are skipped and the count is reported
controls.can_fail_because: fewer than 10 jobs survived the filter
controls.null_must_contain: a query set that returns single keys, which is what a long prefix would give

falsifiers.name: F_witnessing_buys_nothing
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the witnessed verifier fails to reject the non-independent liars, or replication catches them
falsifiers.null_must_contain: two identical wrong answers, which is exactly what replication reads as agreement
falsifiers.refutes: the witnessed route for this job class: if one verifier cannot reject what a 2-of-2 replication check catches, quorum alone is the honest recommendation
falsifiers.fires_when: the witnessed verifier fails to reject the non-independent liars, or replication catches them
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: a single witnessed verifier failing to reject a cheat that 2-of-2 replication catches, which would make the witnessed route redundant for this job class
